title: A route above a road
hook: A crossing can change where two paths meet.

knows: Animals depend on features of their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In a toy scenario, animals that use an overpass cross above vehicle traffic. Which direct encounter can that route avoid?

misconception: A single observation or change determines the same outcome everywhere.
objective: In a toy scenario, animals that use an overpass cross above vehicle traffic. Which direct encounter can that route avoid?

claims.text: In a toy scenario, animals that use an overpass cross above vehicle traffic. Which direct encounter can that route avoid? One panel shows a wildlife path meeting traffic lanes; the other shows a path above the road. For animals that use the overpass, this can separate their crossing from road-level vehicles. This toy drawing does not estimate effectiveness or guarantee use.
claims.source: Stipulated illustrative scenario, not wildlife observations. Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e

claims.text: The panels show a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
An animal uses a wildlife bridge over a road. What does the bridge separate it from while crossing? The bridge places the animal’s route above road-level traffic.
